spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact shipped surfaces: AudioContextOptions.renderSizeHint, BaseAudioContext.renderQuantumSize, AudioWorkletGlobalScope.renderQuantumSize, outputs[0][0].length, and currentFrame deltas, per the Chrome 153 launch scope.

interactive.rationale: Real controls (hint select, custom integer, single probe, full matrix) create genuine AudioContexts and fill a live results table with a per-row verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises a four-way cross-check of the granted quantum including non-power-of-two requests, and the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers omitted hint, both enum values, non-power-of-two 192, custom integers, granted-vs-requested divergence, worklet timeout, autoplay-suspended contexts, and the attribute-missing fallback with exact enable steps.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776 plus the AudioWorkletGlobalScope.renderQuantumSize spec anchor and the sibling/v145 demos.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite mirrors the page's contracts (attribute exposure, default 128, verbatim integer grant, out-of-range throws); on sandbox Chromium 141+flag it reports 5 pass / 3 honest fails.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven in real time via a CDP (Playwright) script on headless Chromium 141 with and without --enable-features=WebAudioConfigurableRenderQuantum; flagged run shows all four observations agreeing at 128 for all 9 hints, unflagged run shows the honest not-exposed rows; console and network clean except the environmental fonts.googleapis stylesheet failure. chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this sandbox, so this is headless-CDP evidence, not MCP evidence.

telemetry_health.rationale: wvq-support asserts the support branch (false on fallback), wvq-probe and wvq-matrix only pass when all four observations are present and agree.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables, WCAG AA pairs (emerald/rose bold on ivory/paper), no button background overrides without color, table scrolls inside an overflow container.

accessibility.rationale: Native select/input/button controls with explicit labels, visible focus from the shared design system, aria-live polite status line announcing probe results, and a semantic captioned table.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x1400: zero horizontal document overflow after the code-wrap fix, 44px control heights, results table scrolls within its own container.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the matrix on a real Chrome 153 build where integer hints are honoured
openQuestions.detail: Sandbox Chromium 141 (with the feature flag) exposes renderQuantumSize but grants 128 for every hint, so the 'granted differs per hint' rendering (multiple distinct sizes in one table) has only been exercised with uniform 128 values. On a Chrome 153 device the same matrix should show 64/128/192/256/512/1024/2048 grants and the agreement verdicts need re-checking there.

openQuestions.title: Screen-reader pass over the results table
openQuestions.detail: The table uses caption + th scope=col and an aria-live status, but no accessibility-tree inspection was possible without chrome-devtools-mcp in this sandbox; verify name/role/value on the verdict cells in a full session.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements, explicit label/for associations, landmarks and sequential headings, and live-region text equivalents for visual state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native select/input/button with for/id labels, main/header/section landmarks, h1-h2 hierarchy, and a role=status aria-live=polite line that mirrors every probe outcome.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap on control rows and intrinsic/minmax sizing instead of fixed widths; keep wide content scrolling inside its own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap:wrap with gap, the results table sits in an overflow-x:auto wrapper with a min-width so the verdict column stays readable, and long code tokens use overflow-wrap:anywhere to keep 360px viewports overflow-free.

guidanceConsulted.query: live audio demo controls with real-time readouts and aria-live status updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous result changes through a polite live region rather than visual-only updates.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The #status element is role=status aria-live=polite and is updated at probe start, per-row completion, and matrix completion.

summary: Four-way verification (main-thread attribute, worklet global, block length, steady-state currentFrame delta) of the granted render quantum across nine hints. Real-time CDP runs on sandbox Chromium 141 show all rows self-consistent at 128 with the flag and an honest not-exposed fallback without it; the first-frame delta burst artefact was found during verification and is deliberately discarded and documented.
